## Highlights

- **Optional builder images per distribution.** `packaging/builders/build.sh`
  builds `git2pkg-builder:arch|debian|fedora|suse` with the complete toolchain.
  If one exists locally, git2pkg uses it and skips the package installation at
  the start of the build: btop drops from about two minutes to 32 seconds,
  hyperfine from 2.5 minutes to 24 seconds. Without an image nothing changes.
- **Native packaging through the project's own recipe.** Repositories that ship
  a `debian/` directory are packaged with `dpkg-buildpackage` (name, version,
  `Depends` and documentation come from the project), and a project-provided
  `*.spec` is used with `rpmbuild`. If the native run fails, the generated path
  runs as before.
- **Upstream bootstrap builds.** Repositories with `x.py` and `src/bootstrap`
  (the Rust compiler) are configured with `--set llvm.download-ci-llvm=true` and
  built/installed through `x.py`; rustc, cargo and clippy are produced and run.

## Changes

- CMake always installs under `/usr`, so packages no longer put files below
  `/usr/local`.
- Versions are read from git tags: tags are fetched for the shallow clone and
  the newest version tag wins (stable releases before alpha/beta/rc).
- Licenses are detected from `LICENSE`/`COPYING` files when a project does not
  declare one; dual licenses are joined with `OR`.
- Failures report their real cause (no artifact, empty package, outdated
  toolchain) instead of "unknown error", and a failed `cargo build` aborts the
  step instead of letting the install step report missing binaries.
- An outdated `rustc` is healed in the same run through rustup.
- Submodules are cloned shallow and in parallel; the Rust clone shrinks from
  about 15 GB/15 minutes to 5 GB/8 minutes.
- Autotools trees without `configure` run their own `bootstrap`/`autogen.sh`.
- Meson dependency errors are understood, `pacman -F` hits with colon versions
  are parsed correctly, and package names no longer get a doubled `lib` prefix.
- Arch dependencies are the direct `DT_NEEDED` libraries only.
- Packages no longer contain invented desktop entries, empty asset directories
  or development files from vendored libraries.
- Python builds get `pip` in the base install and in the builder images.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hyalcin70/git2pkg/compare/v0.2.0-alpha.34...v0.2.0-alpha.35
